title: Certify the finite P104 private macro inverse-transpose
head: 65e58f85d98b4a6344c6221623df1d4caa519604
body:
The original P104 G/2 program cannot be inverse-transposed by swapping individual ADD/COPY directions across its private zero/discard boundaries: the resulting word leaves initial D dirt in public outputs. This package exhibits that exact failure and supplies a finite repair: collapse each of the eight complete private fanouts to its invertible public shear, then realize its dual with a known-zero private accumulator. The resulting complete physical word implements the original channel's inverse-transpose, restores all 72 arbitrary dirty helpers, and has 1,410 native occurrences with rank mass 2,368.

The new owned accumulator contract is explicit. It reverses the private cap-to-line lifetimes, reads independent dirty D values, and discards a nonzero sum. Equal native rank mass does not admit these changed lifetimes to the original pure-copy storage/owner bill. This does not dualize a corrected P104 word or establish a supplier, physical scalar/tape cost, precision reserve, all-size admission, or new kappa.

The package includes the full 4,058-event word, a public-macro proof, exact native transpose/conjugation with positive child normalization, source hashes checked before executable import, attribution, task metadata and open next questions. Source inputs are retained main's original PR1972 word and PR1991 native realization; pending corrected-word packages are not imported. Canonical main was fetched at the round's start and again before commit, unchanged at `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (priority revision 4). The selected record and frozen evidence are unchanged.

Validation on native CPython 3.12.14: normal and optimized exact replays check all 280 inputs, 740 distinct native edges, every transport occurrence, 208 intrinsic adapters and 4,096 full private Gaussian columns. Seven controls detect naive atomwise dualization, wrong gather sign, missing reader, global phase and adjoint/transpose errors, and record the nonzero discard witnesses and equivalent-basis invariance. The registered runner and four read-only/Git-free export, source-before-import, full-word drift and missing-evidence test groups pass. Baseline bindings pass; separate AI-assisted proof/source review and optimized replay found no material issue within the declared contract. No human review or selected supplier cold replay is claimed.

Reproduce with `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-private-macro-dual`. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; prior word, native interpreter, geometry and transposition-method contributors are credited in the README. Advance scope: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2454#issuecomment-6191622309.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
